genre.name: Point & Click Adventure
genre.description: Explore rooms, solve puzzles, uncover stories

story.title: Where Glamour Unweaves
story.setting: The Aether-Geode, a titanic crystal cavern humming with forgotten lament, where the petrified heart of a failed star-god pulses with chaotic energies, causing gravity to shiver and colours to bleed into echoing light.
story.description: You are Skirr, a sentient wisp of residual glamour, able to briefly inhabit the brittle, forgotten Relic-Shells scattered across the fractured Aether-Geode. Explore this collapsing reality, piecing together the chaotic echoes of a dying celestial entity, but choose your interactions carefully: some objects are better left undisturbed, for true salvation may lie in restraint rather than acquisition.

story.title: Iron Psalmody
story.setting: The Iron Thicket groaned, a grotesque forest where trees were gnarled, rust-caked contraptions of bone-white ceramic and oil-slicked brass, constantly whispering a chorus of grinding despair.
story.description: As Thistlewick, a medium sensitive to the suffering of inanimate objects, you must decipher the tortured psychic clamor emanating from the Iron Thicket's infernal "flora." The forest itself is a vast, living mechanism slowly consuming the surrounding reality, and its silent, mechanical "songs" hold the key to stopping its relentless, sanity-warping growth. Progress demands abandoning conventional logic, perceiving paradoxical harmonies within the cacophony, and constructing solutions that violate the very laws of physics to quiet the spectral gears.
